propositions: jira_dc_pat fixture is function-scoped and mints a new PAT per test invocation, causing O(tests) consumption against Jira DC's 10-PAT-per-user cap
fixture mints tokens with expirationDuration=1 but never deletes them, causing budget exhaustion to appear non-deterministic but actually track test count
setup failures mis-attribute to unrelated test modules because the error surfaces at whichever test runs when budget is spent, obscuring the session-wide cause
changing jira_dc_pat to session scope reduces consumption to O(1) since no test asserts per-token behavior
session-start sweep of rebar-j5-harness-* prefixed tokens prevents crashed runs from poisoning subsequent runs with leftover tokens
sweep must degrade safely on enumeration/deletion failures rather than aborting, and must never delete tokens lacking the harness prefix
